notes.title: Welcome to Cozy Cooking!
notes.content:
Hello warm-hearted friends!

Today, we’re excited to embark on this flavorful journey with you as we begin sharing developer diary posts for our game, Cozy Cooking!

Our goal is to bring you along on this adventure, to share the process behind the scenes, and give you a glimpse into the inspirations and decisions that make our game what it is. We hope that through these posts, you'll get to know us better and feel connected to our project!
Firstly, let us introduce ourselves.

[h1]Warm Hearth Studio[/h1]
We’re a small indie team that kicked off development this summer. We share a deep love for cozy, stress-free games that let players relax and unwind. But it doesn’t stop there – we’re also passionate about cooking and can’t get enough of anime! This blend of interests is what fuels our creativity and vision for the game.

[b]What Is Cozy Cooking All About?[/b]
Our goal is to create a unique culinary experience that feels like a warm, inviting escape. We’re designing a meditative space where you can customize your experience and enjoy captivating visuals of beautifully prepared recipes. Here’s a sneak peek at some of the key features we’re currently working on:
[olist]
[*] Character Hand Customization – From feline paws to octopus tentacles, bring your cooking avatar to life in the most fun ways possible.
[*] New Recipes – We’re constantly expanding the menu with new dishes for you to discover and master.
[*] Serving and Photo Mode – Plate your dishes beautifully and share snapshots with friends or the community.
[*] Kitchen Customization – Both cosmetic upgrades and new cooking tools to enhance your cooking space.
[*] Soundscapes and Views – Immerse yourself in the world outside your cozy kitchen with new locations and ambient settings.
[/olist]

We hope you’ll join us on this journey! Adding [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3301520/Cozy_Cooking_Lofi_Beats/]Cozy Cooking to wishlist[/url] is the best way to support our work and keep us motivated to bring this dream to life.
Stay tuned and connected – there’s so much more we can’t wait to share with you! 🌱
